invariant_definitions.COMMUNITY-FGCON-0: Community amendments are subject to FGCON-QUORUM-0 (Phase 119). A single contributor cannot propose and ratify the same amendment. Minimum two distinct governance principals required.
invariant_definitions.COMMUNITY-HUMAN0-0: HUMAN-0 ratification cannot be delegated, automated, or bypassed via any community governance workflow. GPG signature from HUMAN-0's registered key is the only valid ratification signal.

world_first: First constitutionally governed community amendment pipeline with cryptographic HUMAN-0 ratification enforcement and FGCON quorum gate — structurally incapable of autonomous constitutional change
